content: Jahuapachatas cai pachatas mushugyachishcamanda
Chihuashaga jahuapachata cai pachatahuas mushucta ricurani. Ñáaupa tiyac jahuapachaga cai pachandi lamargunandi chingarirami.
Ñáucami ricurani chi sumac llactata, chi mushuc Jerusalen nishcata Diospagmandapacha uraicumuushcata ricurani. Chiga cadsarana huarmi paihua carita tupangahua alichirishcacuinta sumac ricuric mara.
Chasnallata jahuapachamanda sinzhita caparishcata uyarani casna nisha:

content.text: Paigunahuan causangami, paigunas paihua quiquin runaguna manaunga.
Jatun Diosca, paiguna Dios asha paigunahuan pariu causangami.
Diosca paiguna huacashca ñahui yacutas pichasha chaquichingami.
Huañunahuas illangami, huacanahuas, llaquirisha caparinahuas, nanaigunahuas tucuringami.
Tucui chi ñaupa tiyaccuna ña tucurishca manga.

content: Chihuashaga jatun tiyarinaibi tiyauca casnami nira, Ricui, ñucami tucui imatahuas mushucta rac ani nisha. Chasnallata rimahuara, Caita quillcai nisha: Cai shimigunaga quirisha uyaibagmi, sirtu shimigunami.
Chasnallata rimahuara:

content.text: Maican runahuas upinayachiupiga ñuca chi mana ima uraspas tucuric causaita cuc yacuta yangalla cushami.
Ñáucaga paihua Dios tucushami, pai randi ñuca churi tucungami.
Astahuanbas chi shuc runagunaga nina ucuibi causangaraunguna,
tucui chiguna jiridsa asnac sinzhita sindiu nina cuchaibi causangaunami.
Chima rinaga huasha huañunami nisha nirami.

content: Mushuc Jerusalenmanda

Chihuashaga chi puchucai canzhis (7) turmintarina jundashca pillchigunata chariu angelgunamanda shucca ñucahuagma shamusha rimahuara, Caima shamui, Ovejahua cadsarana huarmicuinta acta ricuchishcangui nihuara.
Chihuasha Diospa Samai ñucata japicpi chi angelga shuc yapa jatun urcu jahuama pushahuara. Chima pushasha chi Jerusalen nishca sumac llactata Diospagmandapacha uraicuucta ricuchihuara.
Chi llactaga Diospa sumaghuanpacha punzhaglla ricuric mara. Yapa balic jaspi nishca rumi, cristal nishca yapa chiujlla ali gustu ricuric mara.

Chi llactaga jatun jahua quinzhatami charira, chunga ishcai (12) pungutas charira. Caran pungüibi shuc angel shayaura, chasnallata caran pungüibi quillcashcata charira Israelba chunga ishcai churimanda mirai muntunba shutita.
Indi llucshina partima ara quimsa (3) pungu, chasnallata indi yaicunapuramas quimsa pungu mara, caran tintili partigunamas quimsa pungu mara.
Chi llacta quinzhaga chunga ishcai rumi jahuaibi shayachishca mara. Chi rumigunai Ovejamanda rimangahua japisha cachashca chunga ishcai runagunahua shutigunata quillcashca mara.
Ñáucata rimauc angelga shuc curimanda rashca tupuna barata charira chi llactatas, tucui pungugunatas, quinzhatahuas tupungahua nisha.
Chi llactaga sunimas anzhumas pariulla anaura. Chi llactata tupucpi ishcai huaranga ishcai patsac (2.200) kilometrota charira, sunimas anzhumas jahuamas chi tupullatata charira.
Paihua quinzha altutas tupurami, chiga sucta chunga pichca (65) metrosta charira. Runa tupuna samillahuanda chi angel tupura.
Chi quinzhaga jaspe nishca ali balic rumigunahuan rashca mara. Chi llactaga maillashcacuinta chuyaglla ricuric curihuan rashca mara.
Quinzhangata shayachishca rumigunaga yapa ali rumigunahuan churashca mara:

content.text: Punda quinzhashca rumiga jaspe nishca mara,

content: Cai rumigunaga chunga ishcai (12) tunu manaura. Tucui caigunaga yapa gustu manaura.
Chi chunga ishcai pungugunaga chunga ishcai perlaguna manaura. Caran punguga shuc perlamandalla mara. Chasnallata chi llacta jatun ñambihuas curihuan rashca chiujlla ali ricuric mara.
Chi llactaibi Diosta alabana huasi tiyashcataga maibihuas mana ricuranichu. Jatun ushayuc Diosca Ovejandi alabana huasicuinta manaun.
Chi llactaibi Diospa sumacca punzhayachinmi, Ovejaga bila purucuinta man. Chimandami chi llactaibi indita quillatahuas mana minishtinzhu chibi punzhayachingahua.
Tucui llactagunamanda quishpichishca runagunaga chi punzha llactaibi purinaungami. Chasnallata cai pachaibi jatun mandac amugunaga paiguna ali balic charishcagunata chimallata apamunaungami.
Chibiga tutas illangami. Tucui uras punzhalla aupi chi llacta pungugunata mana tapashcachu anga.
Tucui llactagunai causaccunahuas Yaya Diosta alabasha balichicpi chi llacta yapa balic man nisha ima aligunatahuas chi llactama apamunaurami.

Chi llactamaga ima jiridsahuas mana yaicungachu, imatas huaglichic runahuas llullaccunahuas mana yaicunaungachu. Astahuanbas Oveja chariushca causana quillcaibi quillcashcagunallami chimaga yaicunaunga.
